subject: Portal tidy playbook - cataloging & sample proof buckets
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@crescenthealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-03 09:12 -0700
Subject: Portal tidy playbook - cataloging & sample proof buckets

Hi Alex —

Following up on our intake call: Crescent is moving profile maintenance into a single S3-backed evidence bucket and we want to align on a lightweight "tidy playbook" so we can automate ingestion and avoid duplicate attachments in OneTrust/Vendr. High level asks from our side: 

- Can you confirm which profile fields (SIG/CAIQ/SOC2) you plan to map to individual S3 keys vs. keeping as inline Q&A? We prefer object-level mapping for static artifacts (policies, syslogs, (S)3 export) and inline for short answers.
- Share your preferred upload window (timezone) and whether you can create a temporary uploader principal with scoped PutObject permissions to a path we provide.
- Please attach one representative manifest of your current profile (filenames + rough sizes + field mapping).

I've attached a simple manifest template (redwood_s3_manifest_template.csv) and a compact SIG sample we've used as a reference (SIG_sample_answers_v1.docx). If you can drop the current manifest by EOD Friday (10/09) we can schedule a 30m dry-run next week.

Goal: after the dry-run we run an automated pull to validate CAIQ field links and then flip the portal profile to point at the new S3 buckets. We want minimal downtime on your public profile.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Grace
Grace O'Connor
Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachments: redwood_s3_manifest_template.csv, SIG_sample_answers_v1.docx

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@crescenthealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Crescent Health Security Team <security@crescenthealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-04 11:08 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal tidy playbook - cataloging & sample proof buckets

Grace —

Thanks for the clear checklist. We can do the S3-backed approach; a few clarifications below: 

- Field mapping: we currently store annual SOC2 report, encryption KMS export, and a few PDF policies as objects; short CAIQ answers live inline in the portal. We'll extract the policy PDFs and point them at S3 keys — dpo@crescenthealth will confirm the CAIQ/inline split for ~30 short Qs.
- Upload window: we prefer weekday evenings 10:00PM–2:00AM ET (to avoid QA hours). Are you able to accept uploads in that window?
- Service account: we can provision a temporary service principal with PutObject/ListObject scoped to a prefix (we call it crescent/redwood-ingest/). We'll create creds that expire in 30 days and rotate.

Attached is our current manifest (crescent_current_manifest.csv). A couple of notes in the CSV: some filenames include internal ticket ids that may change after the migration — want to confirm we should preserve original names or standardize mapping.

Proposed timeline: manifest by 10/07, test dry-run 10/12 (evening ET), final switch 10/14 if dry-run passes.

Alex Rivera

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@crescenthealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05 14:20 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal tidy playbook - cataloging & sample proof buckets

Alex —

This looks good, thanks for the manifest. Quick answers and proposals: 

- Evening ET window is fine for us; Redwood S3 presign and ingestion jobs can run from 01:00–03:00 PT (which maps to your 10–12pm ET ask) — that fits within your proposed window.
- Naming: please standardize filenames only where the ticket id is a transient attachment id. For canonical evidence we prefer: <profile_field>_<YYYYMMDD>_<origname> (e.g., soc2_report_20250901_SOC2.pdf). We'll provide a small Lambda that will rename during ingest if you prefer to keep originals.
- Service account: please provision the temporary principal scoped to prefix crescent/redwood-ingest/ and share the creds via your Vault/secure link (do not send creds over email). We'll generate a one-time presign policy for verification.

Next steps I will drive: 
1) Redwood will run a schema validation against crescent_current_manifest.csv and push a short list of missing/ambiguous fields by EOD 10/06.
2) If the dry-run 10/12 looks good, we schedule the portal pointer flip 10/14 (low-traffic window) and communicate a brief status note to your portal admin group.

Ben/jonas — looping you for visibility on scheduling and any sales comms needed for the renewal playbook.

I'll attach a short SIG-answer sample for Crescent's QA team to review (SIG_sample_answers_v1.docx).

— Grace
Grace O'Connor
Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference
